class.name: VideoPreset
class.brief_description: A graphics preset: a name and the settings it sets in the four video settings domains.

method.name: get_domain_settings
method.description: Returns the settings resource of the domain [param domain] (one of [method get_domains]), for example [member render_quality] for [code]"render_quality"[/code], or [code]null[/code] if the preset doesn't touch the domain. Prints an error and returns [code]null[/code] for another domain.

method.name: get_domains
method.description: Returns the settings domains a preset covers, in the order [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.apply_preset] applies them: [code]["render_quality", "texture", "shadow", "render_effect"][/code].

method.name: has_domain_settings
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the preset has a settings resource for the domain [param domain], that is, if applying the preset sets the values of that domain.

method.name: set_domain_settings
method.description: Sets the settings resource of the domain [param domain] (one of [method get_domains]). [param settings] must be the class of the domain (for example [ShadowSettings] for [code]"shadow"[/code]) or [code]null[/code]; otherwise an error is printed and the preset doesn't change.

members.member: The name of the preset, for example [code]"High"[/code]. [VideoPresetSettingsServer] finds presets by this name and stores it as the player's choice. It can't be empty or [code]"Custom"[/code] (see [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.get_custom_preset_name]). Translate it in the user interface with [method Object.tr].
The settings of the domain [code]"render_effect"[/code] ([RenderEffectSettingsServer]): all its values are set when the preset is applied. If [code]null[/code], the preset leaves the domain as it is.

The settings of the domain [code]"render_quality"[/code] ([RenderQualitySettingsServer]): all its values are set when the preset is applied. If [code]null[/code], the preset leaves the domain as it is.
The settings of the domain [code]"shadow"[/code] ([ShadowSettingsServer]): all its values are set when the preset is applied. If [code]null[/code], the preset leaves the domain as it is.
The settings of the domain [code]"texture"[/code] ([TextureSettingsServer]): all its values are set when the preset is applied. If [code]null[/code], the preset leaves the domain as it is.
